input.summary: Cradle when possible, then use the right flipper to send the ball through the left A lane toward the top spin saucer. Build base bonus through upper play and collect it only through favorable wheel awards.

quickInfo.name: Three spin saucers
quickInfo.summary: The top saucer and two side saucers spin the under-playfield award wheel and score the value where it stops.

quickInfo.name: Wheel awards
quickInfo.summary: The wheel can award 3,000, bonus, double or triple bonus, maximum base bonus, an open gate, lit A-B lanes, or star progress.

quickInfo.name: Base bonus
quickInfo.summary: Top rollover disks and the side-of-center standups build base bonus to 10,000, but bonus scores only through a wheel award and resets each ball.

quickInfo.name: A-lane route
quickInfo.summary: The right-flipper shot through the left A lane reaches the top-saucer area and is the preferred repeatable route.

quickInfo.name: Outlane protection
quickInfo.summary: A wheel award can open the right-outlane gate, while the center standup lights the left-outlane ball return; neither risky standup is worth forcing.

steps.text: Let a controllable ball settle on a flipper before choosing the next upper route.
Transfer to or hold the right flipper when that can be done safely.
From the right flipper, shoot through the left A lane toward the top spin saucer.
Accept a broad B-lane feed into the top bumpers when the A lane is unavailable.
Use top rollover disks and natural upper action to build base bonus toward 10,000.
Repeat the top-saucer route to spin the wheel and collect bonus, bonus multipliers, or other useful awards.
Use a lit A or B lane and an opened right gate only through the same safe upper-playfield flow.
Return to a cradle after every survivable top exit and repeat.

fallback.title: B-lane bumper flow
fallback.when: Use this plan when the A-lane shot will not reach the top saucer or its return is unsafe.

steps.text: Stop forcing the A lane from a poor right-flipper angle.
Use a broad shot through the right B lane into the top bumpers.
Let the bumpers find rollover disks and the top saucer naturally.
Read the full top exit before attempting to cradle.
Return to the A-lane route only after its feed becomes reliable.

alternatives.title: Maximum-bonus wheel hunt
alternatives.when: Use this plan when base bonus is near 10,000 and the top-saucer route is controlled.

steps.text: Finish base-bonus advances through upper rollover disks and natural standup hits.
Confirm the current base bonus before the next controlled shot.
Shoot the A lane toward the top saucer.
Repeat the top saucer for bonus, double-bonus, or triple-bonus wheel awards.
Do not substitute either side saucer for the safe top route.
Use A-B upper feeds to reach the rollover disks and top saucer.
Roll over the two small upper disks and hit the side-of-center standups to advance base bonus toward 10,000.
Spin the wheel through the top saucer.
Collect single, double, or triple bonus when the wheel stops there.
Repeat before the base bonus resets at the end of the ball.

playfieldReferences.label: Left A lane
playfieldReferences.description: The left upper lane used to reach the top spin-saucer area.

playfieldReferences.label: Top spin saucer
playfieldReferences.description: The upper saucer that spins the under-playfield award wheel.

techniques.name: Right-flipper A lane
techniques.instruction: Cradle on the right flipper and shoot the left A lane with enough force to reach the top-saucer area.

techniques.name: Cradle
techniques.instruction: When a top exit reaches a flipper slowly, let it settle before choosing A or B instead of flipping immediately near the lower bumper.

techniques.name: Nudging
techniques.instruction: As the ball leaves the top bumpers, use one legal nudge to seek a slow same-side roll or a firm opposite-side bounce toward a flipper.

cautions.issue: The bottom-center bumper can send the ball through the drain or under a flipper.
cautions.response: Keep the ball in the upper routes and avoid flipping late when it is already beside the bottom bumper.

cautions.issue: The three center standups and two side spin saucers are direct rebound hazards.
cautions.response: Do not shoot them deliberately. Use the A-B lanes and top saucer for scoring and wheel access.

cautions.issue: Top-bumper exits frequently return without control.
cautions.response: Prepare both flippers and judge each exit before attempting another upper-playfield shot.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm Fan-Tas-Tic ball count, add-a-ball or replay treatment, and wheel behavior.
Test the A-lane feed, top saucer, right gate, and both upper exits.
